requirements.note: Spec §15.10/J15.11: the chain error reads `chain does not resolve (<reason>)` with reason `target-missing` or `cycle`, and a target is checked against the id grammar only when it names neither an entry nor a renames key (so `"bad name"` draws `target-missing`, and a target that is itself a key is accepted). Code writes reasons `cycle: a -> b -> a` and `ends at "x", which is not in plugins[]`, and checks the grammar first for every non-null target (src/format/marketplace/renames.ts:45-72). The runtime map (follow chain from oldest, null = removed) conforms. Code should change.

requirements.note: Spec §15.6.1 item 2: a backslash after `./` on macOS/Linux is refused by the client at install/load, and validation does not report it. Code reports it at read/validate time (`Path contains a backslash: <path>. Write the path with forward slashes`, src/format/marketplace/plugin-source.ts:79), dropping the entry. requirements.note: Spec (J15.6): a pluginRoot that climbs out with `..` or is absolute makes bare names fail as `Invalid string: must start with "./"`. Code reports its own text `metadata.pluginRoot "<root>" must be a relative path inside the marketplace, so "<name>" cannot resolve under it` (src/format/marketplace/plugin-source.ts:52). `plugins` without `./` read as `./plugins` conforms. Code should use the spec's message.

requirements.note: Spec §15.6.5: a validator reports a non-https or loopback/link-local/metadata archive url as `Archive URLs must use https:// and must not point at a loopback, link-local, or cloud-metadata host`. Code checks only in the fetch plan/install (src/marketplace/source-safety.ts:223, fetch-plan.ts:175) with other texts (`The archive URL "<url>" must use https://`, `... points at a loopback ...`); the entry reader accepts any non-empty url. sha256 pin, 64-hex either case, mismatch refusal conform. Code should add the validator check with the spec's message.

Spec (J15.8): one validator message `command must be printable ASCII (letters, digits, punctuation, single spaces) with no runs of 4 or more spaces`. Code emits three kit-worded messages, one per rule (`The command must be printable ASCII, so users can review all of it`, `The command may have at most 500 characters`, `The command may not contain a run of four or more spaces`; src/format/marketplace/plugin-source-kinds.ts:79-91). Rules themselves (ASCII, 500, four spaces) conform. Code should change to the oracle wording.

Spec (§15.6.7, J15.8): an out-of-range timeout is reported on the field, `plugins.<i>.source.timeout: Too small: expected number to be >0` / `Too big: expected number to be <=600`. Code: readTimeout returns undefined and the whole source is `Invalid input` (src/format/marketplace/plugin-source-kinds.ts:100-117). Range 1..600 and default 60 conform. Code should change.

judgments.note: Code uses three kit messages for the command text rules and folds an out-of-range timeout into `Invalid input` on the source, not `source.timeout: Too small/Too big` (src/format/marketplace/plugin-source-kinds.ts:79-117). Code should change.

Order (path, http(s), SSH, shorthand) and case-insensitive `.json` conform (src/marketplace/marketplace-input.ts). An empty `#ref` on an http(s) git URL (`https://host/r.git#`) silently becomes a `url` source instead of being refused (splitRef undefined -> url, marketplace-input.ts:88-95); on shorthand `owner/repo#` it draws the not-a-valid-shorthand text, not the unrecognized-format one. Code should change.

UTF-16 counting conforms (zod string max); an upper-case `hosts` entry is accepted, and the message is `Invalid host: use a bare hostname, with no scheme, port, or path` (src/format/marketplace/relevance.ts:24-30). Code should change.

Cross-entry gating is a `need not`, so reporting renames always is allowed. Diverges on renames: the grammar check runs before resolution (a renames-key target `bad key` draws PluginIdSchema; `bad name` draws PluginIdSchema instead of target-missing) and reasons are not `target-missing`/`cycle` (src/format/marketplace/renames.ts:45-72). Code should change.
